top_call_exchanges.topic: EDIT-401 Strive Study Initiation & Dose Escalation Strategy
top_call_exchanges.question: With HREC approval and CTN clearance in hand in Australia, what are the next gating items to dosing the first patient in the Strive study before year-end, and when will we see the first clinical biomarker data?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Gilmore O'Neill (CEO): 'We have completed site activation in Australia and screening is actively underway. We remain fully on track to dose our first HeFH patient this year and report initial clinical safety and tolerability metrics in the first quarter of 2027, followed by Part 1 topline efficacy in the second half of 2027.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: AHA 10-Month NHP Durability & Competitive LDL-C Positioning
top_call_exchanges.question: At AHA, you demonstrated >=90% LDL-C reduction sustained over 10 months in NHPs. How does the upregulation mechanism compare to base editing or PCSK9 knockdown approaches in terms of permanence and off-target safety?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Dan Ory (CMO): 'Our targeted upregulation approach directly restores LDLR protein expression, tackling the root etiology of HeFH. The 10-month preclinical durability data in NHPs showed clean liver specificity, transient LFT blips with zero histopathology, and no genotoxicity in primary human cells, creating a potentially best-in-class profile.'

top_call_exchanges.question: Can you provide more context on the second IND acceptance for BMS-986527 in renal cell carcinoma? Does this trigger near-term cash milestones and validate Cas12a commercial royalties?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Gilmore O'Neill (CEO): 'The acceptance of the second IND/CTA for BMS-986527 validates both our Cas12a gene editing platform and our collaboration engine. It triggered a milestone payment recognized this quarter and positions Editas for downstream clinical and commercial milestone payments plus tiered royalties as BMS advances into Phase 1.'
